## Example: an activity-embed slide

<!--
  This is the exact pattern used throughout lecture-01-systems-pharm.qmd. To embed
  a real activity:
    1. Pick an activity folder under activities/<slug>/
    2. Set src to "../activities/<slug>/index.html"
    3. Optionally add a query param: ?seed=12345 (any integer — fixes the
       starting scenario so it's reproducible)
    4. Give the iframe a descriptive `title` attribute (screen readers use it)
    5. Keep the "Reset this activity" button — it reloads just that iframe
-->

::: {.activity-embed-controls}
<button onclick="EmbedBridge.reloadIframe(this)">↻ Reset this activity</button>
:::
::: {.activity-embed}
<iframe class="activity-iframe" loading="lazy" title="REPLACE ME: activity title"
  src="../activities/omic-signatures/index.html?seed=2026"></iframe>
:::

::: {.notes}
Add discussion prompts here: what should students notice? What should you ask
them once they've tried it themselves?
:::
